paracetamol.name: Paracetamol
paracetamol.description: A common painkiller used to treat aches and pain.
paracetamol.uses: Headache, muscle aches, arthritis, backache, toothaches, colds, and fevers.
paracetamol.side_effects: Nausea, stomach pain, loss of appetite, itching, rash, headache, dark urine, clay-colored stools, or jaundice.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
ibuprofen.uses: Reduce fever and treat pain or inflammation caused by many conditions.
ibuprofen.side_effects: Upset stomach, mild heartburn, nausea, vomiting, bloating, gas, diarrhea, constipation.

amoxicillin.name: Amoxicillin
amoxicillin.uses: Used to treat many different types of infection caused by bacteria.

ofloxacin.name: Ofloxacin
ofloxacin.uses: Used to treat bacterial infections of the skin, lungs, prostate, or urinary tract.
